title: AV3: a waiting `once` amount for Free to spend counts on the safe side for it: the smaller
story: Set up Mon 4 Jan 2027: the bank holds 300,000, Free to spend 50,000 (typed). Pay of 250,000 on the 25th (moved earlier), seen on Mon 25 Jan. A moved copy left a one-period Free to spend of 30,000 for the period from the 25 Jan pay waiting for add or replace (`pendingMove`, `share`). Every amount is made up.

asks.question: headline
asks.why: 30,000 (Free to spend this period: the waiting 30,000 is smaller than the usual 50,000, and for Free to spend the safe side is the smaller [AV3]) = 30,000
